title: Touhou Bunkachou ~ Shoot the Bullet - Sleepless Night of the Eastern Country
description:
The repetitive and loosely tense third photo theme from the 9.5 Touhou game, Shoot the Bullet.

I picture this song just as the title describes it, sitting somewhere, doing the same thing over and over again while it's dark outside, feeling completely blank inside. But maybe that's just from me replaying the parts of the game where this plays over and over again.
